description: Since switching to winter clothes I keep scratching rough patches that split when I bend my arms.
Oncoming headlights have rings around them and the subtitles on the television look hazier every month.
Even when the house is completely silent I hear a high electronic whine.
Halfway up the station stairs I get a heavy band across my chest that eases when I stop walking.
I wake up coughing before dawn and hear a whistle each time I breathe out.
After supper I get a burning feeling behind my breastbone and something sour comes back into my throat.
I have to lie in a dark quiet room when the pounding behind one temple starts. I feel sick too.
Both sets of knuckles look puffy and it takes most of the morning before I can close my fists comfortably.
I struggle to reach the top kitchen shelf or fasten clothes behind my back because one arm will not go far enough.
At the toilet I have to wait for anything to come out. When it finally starts the flow is feeble and stops twice.
My child's eyelids are puffy at breakfast and their urine leaves a thick layer of bubbles in the bowl.
I have started sleeping with a water bottle next to me and keep getting up to use the toilet. My clothes are also getting looser.
The cramps I get with my period are bad enough that I miss lectures. The ache sometimes goes into my lower back.
Whenever pollen is high I start sneezing repeatedly and end up rubbing my watering eyes.
Small knocks leave large marks on my legs and the place where a tooth was pulled kept bleeding for much longer than expected.
I have to pause for breath when I carry shopping up the stairs and sometimes feel a tight chest.
I saw red urine this morning and have an ache wrapping around one side of my waist.
My fingers wake me up with pins and needles and I have started dropping mugs.
How do I reschedule a parcel delivery?
Sort these numbers from smallest to largest: 8 2 7.
Can you recommend a novel for the train?
I just feel a bit off.
